description_en: Queries the rankings of inter-region traffic data in the form of 1-tuple, 2-tuple, or 5-tuple. Inter-region traffic data can be ranked by metrics such as traffic volumes and the number of packets
description_zh: 调用GetTransitRouterFlowTopN接口，获取跨域流量详情数据排名，覆盖一元组、二元组、五元组粒度，支持按流量、包数等指标排序
name: GetTransitRouterFlowTopN

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC. The maximum time range that you can query is 24 hours
parameters.help_zh: 查询起始时间的毫秒时间戳。最大支持查24小时跨度的数据
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC. The maximum time range that you can query is 24 hours
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间的毫秒时间戳。最大支持查24小时跨度的数据
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: Specifies the maximum number of data entries to display. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 取最大多少条数据。默认值：10。最大值：100
parameters.name: topn

parameters.help_en:
The direction of the inter-region traffic in the local regions or for the local IP addresses. Valid values:

in: inbound traffic
out: outbound traffic
parameters.help_zh:
对于当前地域或IP的流量方向。取值：
in：入流量。
out：出流量
parameters.name: direction

parameters.help_en:
The dimension for ranking inter-region traffic data. The value of this parameter is case-sensitive. Valid values:

1Tuple: queries the rankings of inter-region traffic data for the local regions, Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instances, and IP addresses.
2Tuple: queries the rankings of inter-region traffic data for the local and remote regions, and the local and remote IP addresses.
5Tuple: queries the rankings of inter-region traffic data for the local and remote IP addresses, local and remote ports, and protocols.
Cen: queries the rankings of inter-region traffic data for CEN instances.
RegionPair: queries the rankings of inter-region traffic data for the local and remote regions.
Port: queries the rankings of inter-region traffic data for the local and remote ports.
Protocol: queries the rankings of inter-region traffic data for the protocols
parameters.help_zh:
指定跨域流量排名的维度，大小写敏感，请注意区分大小写。取值：
1Tuple：查询跨域流量中当前地域、云企业网CEN（Cloud Enterprise Network）、IP维度的排名。
2Tuple：查询跨域流量中两端地域、两端IP维度的排名。
5Tuple：查询跨域流量中两端IP、两端端口和协议维度的排名。
Cen：查询跨域流量中云企业网CEN实例维度的排名。
RegionPair：查询跨域流量中两端地域维度的排名。
Port：查询跨域流量中端口维度的排名。
Protocol：查询跨域流量中协议维度的排名
parameters.name: group_by

parameters.help_en: The local region where the local IP address resides
parameters.name: this_region

parameters.help_en:
The protocol number.

All protocols are supported. This parameter is required only if you set GroupBy to 5Tuple or Protocol
parameters.help_zh:
协议号。

支持全部协议，仅GroupBy配置为5Tuple或Protocol时，才需要配置该参数
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.help_en: The metric for ranking inter-region traffic data. Default value: Bytes. This value specifies that inter-region traffic data is ranked by traffic volume
parameters.help_zh: 数据排序的指标。默认值：Bytes，表示按流量排序
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en:
The order for ranking inter-region traffic data. Valid values:

desc: descending order
asc: ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
流量数据的排序方式。
desc：降序。
asc：升序
parameters.name: sort

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CEN bandwidth plan
parameters.name: bandwith_package_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the member accounts
parameters.name: account_ids

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the multi-account management feature. Default value: false. This value specifies that the multi-account management feature is disabled.

By default, the multi-account management feature is not available. If you want to use this feature, contact your account manager to apply for permissions
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用多账号管理功能。默认值：false。表示不使用。 
多账号管理功能默认不开放，如需使用，请联系商务经理申请使用权限
parameters.name: use_multi_account

TransitRouterFlowTopN.description_en: The ranking result of inter-region traffic data
TransitRouterFlowTopN.description_zh: 跨域流量详情排名列表

BandwithPackageId.description_en: The ID of the CEN bandwidth plan

Bytes.description_en: The total volume of traffic in the specified time range
Bytes.description_zh: 指定时间段内的流量总和

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range that you queried. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC

OtherRegion.description_en: The remote region where the remote IP address resides

Packets.description_en: The total number of packets in the specified time range
Packets.description_zh: 指定时间段内的包数总和

StartTime.description_en: The beginning of the time range that you queried. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC

ThisRegion.description_en: The local region where the local IP address resides
